skills.description: Create, reformat, audit, and finalize delivery-ready formal Chinese Word documents (.docx) using professional typography, semantic tables, pagination, and a render-verified quality system. Use whenever a request involves a formal Word report, guide, proposal, tender, policy, application, case study, attachment, DOCX template, Word-to-PDF export, or repairing a Word document's fonts, tables, whitespace, hierarchy, and final delivery quality.
skills.description_zh:
Word 专业交付
Use this as the default skill for formal Chinese Word deliverables. It is the installed version of the user's Word production standard; do not use a generic visual-card or marketing-page style unless the user explicitly asks for one.

Mandatory reading
Before taking document actions, read the complete professional standard. It is authoritative for scope control, content fidelity, typography, tables, pagination, validation, and delivery.

Then read exactly the task route that applies:

New document: tasks/create_new.md
Existing document reformat or repair: tasks/reformat_existing.md
Document structure: tasks/build_structure.md
Table design or repair: tasks/style_tables.md
Render review: tasks/verify_render.md
Final cleanup and delivery: tasks/finalize_delivery.md
Use the corresponding detailed references when the task needs them:

Layout selection: references/adaptive_decision_tree.md
Font system: references/typography_rules.md
Design tokens: references/style_tokens.md
Tables: references/table_rules.md
QA: references/qa_checklist.md
Environment limitations: references/known_limitations.md
Operating rules
Diagnose the requested action, the exact delivery object, and what is out of scope before writing or editing.
Preserve facts, numbers, dates, units, sources, conclusions, and user-provided terminology. Do not introduce unapproved content, a cover, an executive summary, or extra sections.
Treat supplied files as read-only. Create a separate output file; never overwrite, remove, or move the original.
Build or repair the style system first. Use the user's formal Chinese hierarchy, restrained grayscale palette, semantic table layout, natural pagination, and dynamic header/footer rules.
Use native Word structures for headings, lists, tables, captions, page breaks, headers, and page numbers. Do not imitate a slide deck with decorative cards, excessive color blocks, or image-rendered text.
For multi-section documents, write and review one major section at a time. Re-read inserted text and its style immediately; correct style inheritance or list leakage before proceeding.
Run the required audits, render every page, visually inspect every page at 100%, repair every defect, then re-render. Do not claim completion based on a partial preview.
Finalize only the clean delivery file. Default to DOCX; export PDF only when requested. Do not return temporary renders, debug files, or near-duplicate versions.
Tools and bundled material
Use the retained tools rather than recreating their checks:

scripts/formal_style_pack.py — Word styles and formal document helpers
scripts/font_declaration_audit.py — verifies DOCX East Asian, ASCII, and HAnsi font declarations
scripts/heading_audit.py — checks heading hierarchy and title consistency
scripts/table_alignment_audit.py — checks semantic alignment and layout risks in tables
scripts/render_and_verify.py — produces page renders and a basic completeness check; manually inspect every page afterward
scripts/finalize_docx.py — creates a clean final copy without overwriting the source
Read examples/ only when a similar structure is needed. Run tests/smoke_test.py after changing bundled scripts. Use requirements.txt with the bundled workspace runtime if dependencies must be checked.

Delivery response
After a document task, respond briefly with the completed file link and only the verified scope. Do not narrate implementation details, repeat the document, add unasked-for advice, or describe all files as checked unless they were checked.
skills.name: Word专业交付

skills.description_zh:
把 Al Brooks 全套价格行为课程蒸馏成可调用的 Agent Skill：读图 → 判方向 → 选 Setup → 验方程 → 给出入场/止损/止盈/仓位建议。

Al Brooks 价格行为完整 Skill 包（36 个子技能）。教 Agent 按 Brooks 体系读图决策：趋势/震荡、Always In、80% 惯性、背景优先、H1/H2 与信号 K 入场、MTR/楔形/高潮、止损止盈与交易者方程。适用于盘中问答、Setup 筛选、复盘，以及把规则写成 EA/Pine。输出固定为：背景 → 形态 → 方程校验 → 做/不做（含止损/目标/仓位）。

Al Brooks Price Action skill hub (36 child skills). Guides the agent to read charts like Brooks: Trend vs TR, Always In (AIL/AIS), 80% inertia, context-first, H1/H2/L1/L2 and signal-bar stop entries, MTR/wedge/climax, protective stops, trader’s equation (P×R vs risk), and trade management. Use for Brooks PA Q&A, setup selection, chart analysis, or translating rules into EA/Pine logic. Returns Context → Setup → Equation → do/don’t with stop/target/size.

它干了什么
面向「看 K 线做交易决策」的 Agent，提供一整套 Brooks 方法论：

能力	具体做什么
读图语言
趋势 K / 震荡 K、背景优先、Always In（AIL/AIS）
市场状态
趋势 vs 震荡；突破→窄通道→宽通道→TR 四阶段
概率默认
80% 法则：趋势中反转多失败；TR 中突破多失败
入场体系
H1/H2、L1/L2、信号 K + Stop（±1 tick）
结构形态
突破、通道、TR 三分区、MTR、楔形、高潮等
执行风控
保护性止损、实际风险、2R/3R 分批、仓位 ≤3%
决策数学
交易者方程：P × 利润 > (1-P) × 风险
输出格式
Context → Setup → Equation → 做/不做 + 管理要点
调用时：用户丢图表描述 / OHLC 问题 /「现在该多还是空」，Agent 按 八步流水线 走完并给出可执行结论，而不是空泛行情点评。

有什么特色
课程级完整，不是零散 tips
覆盖 Brooks 课程模块 01–52（约 187 段视频字幕蒸馏），共 36 个子 skill：从读图基础到开盘/MTR 实战、亏损归因。

Hub + 子技能路由
一个入口 skill 按意图分发到具体模块（Always In、H2、TR Fade、止损等），避免把整套知识一次塞进上下文。

可执行，不只可解释
每条路径落到：方向、入场价逻辑、止损锚点、目标 R 倍数、仓位规则、前提失效离场——适合人工交易，也适合转 EA / Pine。

统计默认写进决策
内置 Brooks 常用参考胜率与最低 R:R（如强趋势逆势默认不做、H1 须 ≥2R），用「惯性」约束瞎抄底摸顶。

诚实边界
标明 80% 是经验法则、背景判断有主观性、需回测校准——适合认真交易者，不包装成「稳赚系统」。

中英术语对齐
附带 ~175 条术语词典（Always In、Signal Bar、MTR、BLSHS 等），Agent 输出可与原课程语言一致。

适合谁调用
学 / 用 Al Brooks Price Action 的交易者
需要 Agent 按 Brooks 框架复盘或盯盘 的人
把 Brooks 规则落成 自动交易 / 回测 的开发者
问「现在顺势还是 fade、这个 H2 能不能做」这类决策问题的用户
不适合：要指标金叉死叉、要「必胜信号」、完全不懂 K 线还想一键躺赢的场景。

触发关键词（方便发现）
Al Brooks · price action · Always In · AIL · AIS · 80% · H2 · L2 · signal bar · trading range · BLSHS · MTR · wedge · climax · trader's equation · protective stop · 价格行为 · 单边 · 高2 · 震荡区间 · 大反转
